info.title: GenAI Output Messages
info.description: Schema for the gen_ai.output.messages attribute, describing the messages generated by a GenAI model or agent.

OutputMessages.description: Represents the list of output messages generated by the model or agent.
x-otel-deviation: The deprecated finish_reason field is omitted. Finish reasons belong in gen_ai.response.finish_reasons.

ExtractOutputMessages.description: Represents the output messages of a gen_ai.extract operation. The list holds one message.
x-otel-deviation: OTel does not define the extract operation. This definition is specific to Sentry.

ExtractOutputMessage.description: Represents the extraction response body as the provider returned it, without the model and the usage. Other keys of the response body are permitted.

answers.description: One answer for each field in the input, keyed by field name.

truncated.description: Whether an answer is incomplete or invalid.

state_text.description: The text that the spans index into, if the provider returns it.

ExtractAnswer.description: Represents the answer for one field. The other keys depend on the field type and the provider, such as guess, p_null, mean, and median.

value.description: The extracted value. It is null when the model cannot determine the field.

confidence.description: The probability, from 0 to 1, that the answer is correct.

span.description: The location of the value in the text, or null when the value has no unique location.

spans.description: For a list answer, the location of each item in the text, or null for an item that has no unique location.

ExtractSpan.description: Represents a [start, end] pair of character offsets into state, or into state_text if the provider returns it. The end offset is exclusive.
